Info loker dari VOIE Fragrance

WE'RE HIRING! 🫧✨

Ready to turn your passion into something meaningful? 👀

@voiefragrance is looking for creative, passionate, and driven people to grow with us! If you're excited about creating content, connecting with people, or building exciting collaborations, maybe you're the one we're looking for. 🤍

Here are the positions we're opening:

🎬 Content Creator Intern
🎤 Host Live — Full Time & Paid Internship
🤝 KOL & Affiliator — Full Time & Paid Internship

📍 Work Location: Yogyakarta (WFO)

We're looking for people who are eager to learn, love exploring new ideas, and are ready to grow together with the team.

Think you're a good fit? Or know someone who might be? Tag them or share this post! 💌

📩 Apply now and be part of the journey with VOIE Fragrance!

Let's create something meaningful together. ✨
